sections.title: Authentication Overview
sections.text: The Atlas service accepts signed access tokens issued by the identity gateway.

sections.title: Token Rotation
sections.text: Access-token signing keys rotate every 24 hours, and the current key identifier is ATLAS-KV-104.

sections.title: Cache Behavior
sections.text: The service caches validated token metadata for five minutes to reduce repeated verification work.

sections.title: Deployment Notes
sections.text: Atlas runs in three regional clusters and uses rolling deployments.

sections.title: Storage Overview
sections.text: The Borealis database stores customer profile records in replicated partitions.

sections.title: Backup Policy
sections.text: Full backups run every Sunday, while incremental backups run every six hours.

sections.title: Encryption
sections.text: Backup archives are encrypted with key BOREALIS-BK-77 before leaving the primary region.

sections.title: Restore Process
sections.text: Operators restore the most recent full backup and then replay available incrementals.

sections.title: Queue Overview
sections.text: The Cirrus worker system consumes asynchronous jobs from a durable queue.

sections.title: Retry Policy
sections.text: Failed jobs use exponential backoff and are retried at most five times.

sections.title: Dead Letter Handling
sections.text: A job that fails all retry attempts is moved to the dead-letter queue named CIRRUS-DLQ.

sections.title: Observability
sections.text: Queue depth and retry counts are exported as monitoring metrics.
